sentences.en: American International Group Insurance (AIG) is a leading insurance provider operating in more than 130 countries.
sentences.vi: American International Group Insurance (AIG) là nhà cung cấp bảo hiểm hàng đầu hoạt động tại hơn 130 quốc gia.

sentences.en: Though their main emphasis is on auto insurance and mortgage guaranty insurance operation, AIG Insurance has an extensive line of insurance products.

sentences.en: Below is a rundown of the main insurance products offered by AIG.

sentences.en: Their prices are competitive and most individuals find they can save an average of $359.00 each year by purchasing an AIG auto insurance policy.

sentences.en: A wholly owned subsidiary of AIG Travel Services, Inc, Travel Guard International is the leading provider of travel insurance plans in the U.S., covering more than 6 million travelers each year.
sentences.vi: Là công ty con thuộc sở hữu hoàn toàn của AIG Travel Services, Inc, Travel Guard International là nhà cung cấp các gói bảo hiểm du lịch hàng đầu tại Hoa Kỳ, bảo hiểm cho hơn 6 triệu khách du lịch mỗi năm.

sentences.en: The best part about AIG Insurance is their customer service.
